reviewPolicyChanges.authorization: User: "the independent review thing can be eliminated for all i care if it isnt going to break anything"
reviewPolicyChanges.scope: Future entry revisions, additions, source decisions and merge approvals require exact author review; an independent second pass is optional. Historical batches retain their original policy and approvals. Full teaching, evidence, pitch investigation, immutable identities, reference bindings and runtime validation remain required.

reviewPolicyChanges.authorization: User chose "Exclude: kanji-reading row" for bare-kanji publisher rows (5 October 2026).
reviewPolicyChanges.scope: A publisher row giving a bare kanji with a character reading and kanji-dictionary meanings is excluded unless JMdict has a word for that spelling, reading and sense; when it does, the row maps to that card with additional-sense. Rows whose gloss belongs to a different word are excluded as source mix-ups. Documented in README.md (Kanji-reading rows) and scripts/vocabulary-batch.md.
